signature.name: VTask.domCongrAlg
signature.type: (k : Type u_1) -> {G : Type u_2} -> {H : Type u_3} -> (A : Type u_4) -> [Monoid G] -> [Monoid H] -> [Semiring A] -> [CommSemiring k] -> [Algebra k A] -> [MulSemiringAction G A] -> [MulSemiringAction H A] -> [SMulCommClass G k A] -> [SMulCommClass H k A] -> {e : G ≃* H} -> (he : ∀ (a : G) (x : A), a • x = e a • x) -> SkewMonoidAlgebra A G ≃ₐ[k] SkewMonoidAlgebra A H

conventions.statement: When `e = MulEquiv.refl G` and `he = fun _ _ ↦ rfl`, `VTask.domCongrAlg k A he` equals `AlgEquiv.refl`.
conventions.note: Established by the theorem `domCongr_refl` in the Mathlib neighborhood.
